name: Cradle Bay bed
specification: Low hum ~49 Hz fundamental, faint air, slow wobble; warm, close.

name: Observation Lab bed
specification: Hum ~55 Hz, wider, hint of window wind.

name: The Well bed
specification: Sub ~41 Hz with slow breathing pulse.

name: ECHO on
specification: Swelling inverted tone rising ~180->720 Hz + static puff.

name: Confirm
trigger: choice made, card taken, door accept

name: Typewriter tick
specification: Tiny high click; must not fatigue.

name: Key snap
specification: Small dry snap; the sound of the argument.

name: Door slide / locker open
notes: Locker uses this too; dedicated locker sound is P1.

name: ORPHEUS speaks
specification: Two soft sine notes with echo; no per-letter beeps.

name: Keypad tones x4
specification: Four distinct soft tones; same four pitch relations as the motif.

name: Footstep metal (4 variants)
specification: Soft boot on metal floor; barely audible.

name: Title music
specification: Sparse pad + motif fragment, low intensity.

name: Station investigation bed
specification: Cold pad, sub, distant metal; intensity 1.

name: R-017 reveal
specification: Mostly silence; one sustained tone then nothing.

name: Final decision
specification: Name-question loop as rhythm; very sparse.

name: Ending: relay
specification: Motif restarts with a detuned note.

name: Lethe cascade
specification: Layered fragments rising then dropping out oldest-first.

name: Lights dim, hum drops a fifth
specification: Hum falls ~ a fifth; no sting.
